place_fields.summary: Kadike Beach is a beach in the Udupi area of coastal Karnataka.

planning_attributes.description: Kadike Beach is listed among the beaches of Udupi district.

place_fields.summary: Malpe Sea Walk is a paved sea-walk and breakwater promenade at Malpe on the Udupi coast; a GitHub travel guide describes a paved 500-meter walkway and beach promenade.

planning_attributes.description: The Malpe Sea Walk is described as a paved 500-meter walkway along the breakwater, with the sea walk and wide white-sand beach forming the coastal setting.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The GitHub guide describes a designated buoy-marked swimming zone and stationed lifeguards at the beach; it also advises against using a seasonal floating bridge with an infant.
planning_attributes.notes: The same GitHub guide identifies the sea walk at the southern tip where the Malpe river meets the sea.

place_fields.summary: Kadiyali Shri Mahishamardini Temple is a Hindu temple in Kadiyali, Udupi, Karnataka.

planning_attributes.description: The temple is identified in GitHub-based Udupi tourism material as Kadiyali Mahishamardini Temple, and the supplied listing places it in Kadiyali, Udupi.
